text: EX-053: gaps addressed. (1) Youtube.tsx — modestbranding=1 documented as branding policy (removes YouTube logo); rel=0 documented as privacy policy (restricts related videos to same channel). Loop behavioral limitation confirmed: YouTube loop requires playlist={videoId} parameter to function in embed mode; the widget does NOT include playlist param, so loop=true has no effect on YouTube. (2) SizeContainer.tsx — default aspect ratio is sixteenByNine (16:9, HD video standard). Designer choice guidance added. Misconfiguration impacts documented: undefined heightAspectRatio produces ratioHeightFactor=0 → paddingTop=0 → zero-height invisible container; wrong ratio produces letterboxing/pillarboxing; percentageOfParent without defined parent height collapses container. (3) editorConfig.ts — height/heightUnit constraint documented: height is hidden in aspectRatio mode because height would be contradictory (ratio computes height from width×factor); heightAspectRatio is hidden in non-aspectRatio modes; constraint is Studio Pro UI only — not enforced at TypeScript/runtime level. UX implication: switching modes preserves hidden values (not deleted). (4) CHANGELOG.md v3.1.1 — confirmed from source (not inference): VideoPlayer.tsx line uses key={poster ? url-poster : url} on Video component. Key change forces React unmount+remount of Video and its iframe — confirmed mechanism for the fix. iframes do not respond to src prop changes alone; key-based re-mount is required. (5) Architectural choices section added covering: URL-based key pattern (confirmed v3.1.1 fix mechanism; note: 'SafeDOM' referenced by reviewer does not exist in codebase), TypeScript interface-level prop exclusion per platform, and HTML5 direct DOM ref manipulation for error state (avoids React re-render that would reset video element internal state).
